m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The agents of Chaos think they can stop me with so meager a wall? Ha!
Aaahahaha!
This wall is like nothing I've ever encountered. As if it was made of pure darkness. Just being near it causes me... despair! Oh no...
'The land shall first be cleaved in twain with bricks of darkness mortared in fear.' The Prophecy of War... Zanadu is running out of time!
The Aethyrium is just beyond this pernicious partition, but I can see no way through. Oh, I hope Zigi and Alyvia made it out before-
Hey, you there! I need your help! Please!
A child? A king's duty to his people never ceases! Quickly, we must aid this tow-headed Alphoi lad.
Shadow Creatures... they're everywhere! They chased us-
Worry not, gentle Alphoiling, for your king, Kubla Khan, has returned to save you.
You... you're Khan? THE Khan?
Indeed I am.
Right. And I'm Queen Shaka. But this Wizard looks tough. Listen, I'll help you get wherever you're going if you'll rescue my mother first!
We were being chased by a pack of Shadow Creatures, but Mother diverted them away from me by running into that abandoned House there.
She's still trapped inside. Please, Wizard, you have to save my Mother from those dark-hearted monsters! My mother is all I have in this world.
Grrrrraaaarrrwwl!
Stay back, you ghastly globs of gloom! Hey, you! Don't just stand there, help me! Please!
Thank you for saving my life, Stranger. But... please, my son... he's still out there with... them. You must find- Ben'Jamyn!
Mother! You're safe! Thank you, Wizard!
Thanks to you, my beloved son and I are safe... for the time being anyway. Can we ever repay you for your kindness and valor?
You seek Zigi Stardust? I'm sorry, but you may as well return to wherever you came from. Zigi, like Zanadu, is under <ITALICS>His</ITALICS> control now.
She's talking about the Bat. He's the worst! First, he extinguished the Beacon of Hope. Then he took over the Aethyrium and locked Zigi up inside!
Then he stole the Radiant Throne right out from under Alyvia the Muse. We all tried to fight back. Honest. Even me and Mother!
Yes, but the more we fought, the more Shadow Creatures Bat summoned upon us. Eventually, the Shadow overtook everything. Even our homes.
Rather than continue fighting, Khan's hapless puppet, the Muse, convinced the Alphoi to flee from Bat and his Shadow Creatures.
The Light Brigade converted the Theater District into a stronghold of sorts. The Alphoi have taken to calling it the 'Comfort Zone'.
Now, what remains of our people hide behind a thin veil of denial and false security that the Muse manufactures inside her 'Leisure Dome'.
But we don't need them! Let them make merry with their heads buried in the sand, we'll take care of ourselves out here. Right, Mother?
Uhhh... that's right, my love. And this House seems like a fine place to start. Thank you again, Wizard. May the Light guide you.
There you are! I couldn't get the boy to talk before he ran inside when those Shadow Creatures limped out. Were you able to question him?
A bat caused this? Oh, <ITALICS>The</ITALICS> Bat. The one Pork mentioned? I see. And Zigi's a captive? Blast! Did the child mention an Alyvia the Muse?
...Retreated with my people to a stronghold called the Comfort Zone? Then we must go there at once!
The Muse may possess valuable information about the Bat, and possibly a way we can reach the Aethyrium. Come, we should update the crew.
Shadow Magic abominations... if I had to guess. Probably the twisted minions of Grandfather Spider's whelp, the Bat.
I'm beginning to fear finding this Zigi Stardust character is going to prove more difficult than we'd previously envisioned.
You're back... sans Zigi Stardust. What happened? Were you unable to locate her?
Do I know where Zigi is? Perhaps. How to reach her, ah... that is another matter. Your Bat has built a frightful Wall of darkness to impede us.
Well then, good thing we have Sparck. Mr. Sparck! How long until your Streamportal device is up and running?
Unfortunately, Captain, I am detecting high levels of terrorpeptides in the air. I believe they are the primary component of said Wall.
Ahh... terrorpeptides. I knew it!
Something terrible has transpired here, Wizard. The air is thick with sadness and... fear. The Prophecy of War has come to pass!
These streets should be teeming with Alphoi... yet they are derelict, lifeless, empty except for those... creatures. What are they?
I am too late. The Prophecy has come to pass... War has come. But as long as I draw breath, I will not stop fighting for my dear Zanadu!
And neither would Zigi. If she's anywhere amongst this madness, the Aethyrium is where we'll find her. Come, Wizard, to the Aethyrium!
The Crew should stay and guard the Streamportal, as it is our only way back to Aeriel. I will use this time to continue to refine the network.
